For you, Diya

My dearest birthday girl,

Happy birthday to the person who makes my world feel warmer just by being in it.

I hope you know how much I adore the person you are: your heart, your light, your laugh, and all the little things that make you unmistakably you. Getting to share life's ordinary moments with you is one of the loveliest gifts I could ask for.

Today is yours. I hope it brings you the same joy, comfort, and love you give so freely to everyone around you. May this next year surprise you with beautiful things, and may we keep collecting our little moments together—one day, one laugh, one memory at a time.

I'm so lucky I get to call you my person. Happy birthday, my love. Today, tomorrow, and every day after: I'm cheering for you.

All my love, always ♡
